description: Fetches one of the sandbox's paid endpoints (HTTP 402, x402) through the spendctl sidecar: https://weather.sandbox.spendctl.dev/weather?city=<name> ($0.01) or https://search.sandbox.spendctl.dev/search?q=<query> ($0.02), as listed by sandbox_create and documented at https://spendctl.dev/docs/sandbox/. The sidecar applies the sandbox agent's budget, allowlist and approval policy, pays with the throwaway wallet if allowed, and returns the response. A refusal or a pending approval is explained in the result. Only sandbox hosts exist; no real funds are involved.

approvalId.description: An approval id that a human approved, to retry the held payment

dryRun.description: Only report what spendctl would do; never pay

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when retrying so the sandbox is never charged twice

url.description: Absolute URL of a sandbox endpoint, e.g. https://weather.sandbox.spendctl.dev/weather?city=Kyoto

name: sandbox_pay
title: Fetch a paid sandbox URL
